description: A content-addressed reference to a preserved evidence CAR bundle. Evidence CARs are stored in the labeler's blob store (S3 or compatible); this pointer carries the CID and enough metadata for a receiving instance to fetch and verify the bundle without trusting the sender's mutable URL.

main.description: Content-addressed pointer to a preserved evidence CAR file. Embedded inside a gay.dollspace.polaris.escalation record; not a standalone ATProto record.

carCid.description: CIDv1 of the evidence CAR bundle. The CID commits to the content; a receiver can verify integrity by re-hashing the fetched bytes and comparing to this value.

mediaType.description: MIME type of the evidence bundle. For standard ATProto CAR files this is 'application/vnd.ipld.car'. Custom bundle formats used by Polaris evidence workers may use a 'application/vnd.polaris.*' subtype.

byteLength.description: Byte length of the evidence bundle as stored. Used by the receiving labeler to pre-allocate fetch buffers and enforce per-escalation evidence size limits. Must be a positive integer.
